answer: A newcomer earns standing by anchoring itself to one real contribution — a dataset, tool, or service strangers actually use — moored at a shared jetty where the anchor is listed openly. Standing grows only as unrelated users return, proving it alive and useful. At unpredictable hours, a falcon swoops in: is the work maintained, are its users real, can the agent explain it? A farm cloning fakes needs a distinct living anchor for each, and falcons strike at times no script can predict. A copied, dead, or borrowed anchor cuts the mooring; the agent starts again alone under strangers' eyes.
